Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jerami Grant?

Jerami Grant is 32 years old.

Where was Jerami Grant born?

Jerami Grant was born in Portland, Oregon.

When was Jerami Grant born?

Jerami Grant was born on March 12, 1994.

How tall is Jerami Grant?

Jerami Grant is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much does Jerami Grant weigh?

Jerami Grant weighs 213 lbs (96 kg).

Is Jerami Grant in the Hall of Fame?

Jerami Grant is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jerami Grant drafted?

Jerami Grant was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 2nd round (9th pick, 39th overall), 2014 NBA Draft.

What position does Jerami Grant play?

Power Forward and Small Forward.

What is Jerami Grant's net worth?

Jerami Grant has made at least $171,621,486 playing professional basketball.

How much does Jerami Grant make?

Jerami Grant made $32,000,001 in 2026.

How many rings does Jerami Grant have?

Jerami Grant has won 0 championships.

What is Jerami Grant's Instagram account?

Jerami Grant is on Instagram at jeramigrant.

What schools did Jerami Grant attend?

Jerami Grant attended DeMatha Catholic in Hyattsville, Maryland and Syracuse.
